children: TATA TRUSTS: HAVE NOT AGREED TO LISTING OF TATA SONS
TATA TRUSTS: TATA SONS BOARD AGREED THAT ALL AVAILABLE OPTIONS, AND NOT LISTING ALONE, SHOULD BE THOROUGHLY EXPLORED ON IMMEDIATE BASIS
TATA SONS LISTING WILL DESTROY ITS CHARACTER AND STRIKE AT THE HEART OF THIS PRINCIPLE - NOEL TATA
TATA TRUSTS: TATA SONS BOARD HAD ALREADY CONSIDERED MATTER OF PUBLIC LISTING, REACHED CONCLUSION IN MARCH 2024 THAT CO SHOULD REMAIN UNLISTED
TATA TRUSTS: SUPPORTS CONSTRUCTIVE, INFORMED, LAWFUL PROCESS THAT ENABLES ALL PERMISSIBLE OPTIONS TO BE EXAMINED COMPREHENSIVELY
TATA TRUSTS: SEPARATE BOARD MEETING WILL BE CONVENED TO CONSIDER ASSESSMENT AND DETERMINE THE APPROPRIATE COURSE OF ACTION ON TATA SONS LISTING
TATA TRUSTS: STRUCTURE OF GROUP'S OWNERSHIP HAS PERMITTED TATA SONS TO ACT REPEATEDLY IN WAYS THAT A PURELY COMMERCIAL CALCULUS WOULD NOT HAVE SUPPORTED
